`abstract class StackUIBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIBridge`](/reference/backends/uibridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`WindowUIBridge`](/reference/backends/windowuibridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StackUIBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/ui/StackUIBridge.java)

A UI bridge in which opening a screen closes the open screens and popups, while overlays and popups stack above them.

## Description

It is the usual base of a UI bridge of your own: you keep the usual opening and closing and override what your host needs.
[UI bridge](/build/bridges/ui/#example) shows one that takes every overlay.

## Learn more

- [Add a UI bridge of your own](/use/learn/running/embedding/#add-a-ui-bridge-of-your-own)
- [UI bridge](/build/bridges/ui/)

## Creation details

<a id="StackUIBridge-constructor"></a>

### StackUIBridge

`StackUIBridge()` 

Creates a UI bridge with no open UI, for a subclass.

## Method details

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-open"></a>

### open

`void open(UI ui)` 

Opens the UI.
An open UI moves to the front and its closing transition stops; an overlay or a popup is added; a screen first closes every open screen and popup that `canReplace` accepts, and waits for their closing transition before it is added.
A UI that refuses to close keeps the screen from opening, with a dev warning.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-close"></a>

### close

`void close(UI ui)` 

Removes the UI; when it was leaving for a screen waiting behind its transition, that screen opens.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-add"></a>

### add

`void add(UI ui)` 

Adds the UI and lays it out at the size of the window; calls `attachScreen()` when it is the first screen or popup.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-remove"></a>

### remove

`void remove(UI ui)` 

Removes the UI; calls `detachScreen()` when it was the last screen or popup.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-canHandle"></a>

### canHandle

`boolean canHandle(Class<? extends UI> clazz)` 

Returns `true`: the bridge accepts every UI.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-forceOpen"></a>

### forceOpen

`void forceOpen(UI ui)` 

Closes every UI and opens this one, without calling `detachScreen()` and `attachScreen()` between them when a screen stays open.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-replace"></a>

### replace

`void replace(UI ui, UI replacement)` 

Replaces the first UI with the second, without calling `detachScreen()` and `attachScreen()` between them.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-canReplace"></a>

### canReplace

`boolean canReplace(UI ui)` 

If `true`, opening a screen closes this open screen or popup; it returns `true` by default.
Return `false` to keep the UI below the new screen.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-attachScreen"></a>

### attachScreen

`void attachScreen()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it when the first screen or popup of the bridge opens; overlays do not count.
Override it to free the cursor of the host or pause its input; it does nothing by default.

<a id="StackUIBridge-method-detachScreen"></a>

### detachScreen

`void detachScreen()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it when the last screen or popup of the bridge closes; overlays do not count.
Override it to give the cursor and the input back to the host; it does nothing by default.
